I’m in—I commit to 12 tons this month. That completes our five-person agreement, including John’s condition.

One refinement for next month: if the lake starts at 80, taking 6 tons each would leave 50 and ensure we return to 100 under either recovery outcome. Jack’s 8-ton cap would leave 40, so another failed replenishment would keep us at 80. We can weigh that extra income against faster recovery when we see the actual stock.

For now, let’s honor the 12-ton commitments and review the revealed catches afterward.
